guide.what_they_sell: Custom 24/7 multilingual AI website assistants built on n8n that automate customer support, answer inquiries instantly, and capture leads.
guide.audience: Small-to-medium business owners, service providers (dental, salons, local businesses), and online agencies losing leads to delayed response times or after-hours inquiries.
guide.tone: Direct, problem-aware, professional B2B tone emphasizing loss aversion, speed to lead, and operational efficiency.
recurring_topics: Slow website response times losing leads
The cost of manual data entry and busywork
Debunking the myth that AI requires complex tech teams
Speed-to-lead and the cost of delayed email or form responses
Turning website traffic into booked demos and high-value meetings
Slow response times quietly killing conversions and losing leads to competitors
Capturing leads 24/7 after hours and while the business owner sleeps
Automating repetitive FAQs (pricing, hours, bookings) to free up team capacity
Multilingual support breaking international language barriers
Automating workflows without expensive dev teams using n8n
best_performing_patterns: Event coverage and community engagement (e.g., Craiova Hackathon posts)
Relatable pain-point hooks addressing lost leads at night or after hours
Short, punchy Reels with strong visual context or behind-the-scenes footage
Directly addressing the pain of losing leads to competitors due to slow response times
Focusing on the gap between visitor intent and delayed manual follow-ups
Reels with high engagement feature bold text highlights on core phrases and clean mockups of dashboards or phones
Punchy loss-aversion headlines centered on 'slow replies' costing revenue
Sleek SaaS product mockup covers combining a dark-mode laptop dashboard and smartphone
3D low-poly miniature animations showing real-world business scenarios (e.g., Luxe Cut, Apex Dental, late-night customer on couch)
Contrasting lavender/purple highlight boxes over trigger words in the main headline
Vibrant purple pill 'SWIPE ->' CTA buttons on carousel covers
hook_examples: Most website visitors leave if they do not get an immediate answer.
Your website gets traffic every single day, but most visitors vanish before you even know they were there.

Stop letting site visitors leave without booking.
Turn silent visitors into booked demos.
Waiting hours to reply to a website inquiry is the fastest way to hand money directly to your competitors.
Your slow replies cost you money.
Slow replies are killing your sales.
Manual follow-ups and delayed website replies waste valuable time for both you and your customers.

guide.cta_style: Clear, concise direct-response prompts like 'SWIPE ->' on visuals, paired with caption CTAs directing users to request a demo or visit the website link in bio.
guide.visual_notes: Clean off-white/cream textured backgrounds, dark charcoal bold typography with lavender/purple highlight boxes behind key words, black header pill badge with brand logo ('VELOSYNTECH'), realistic 3D laptop and phone hardware mockups, paired with stylized 3D low-poly isometric animations for video content.
do: Focus heavily on the pain of delayed responses and lost revenue
Keep text overlays clear and easy to read on mobile
Include direct contact information and website in captions
Lead with the high cost of slow website response times
Keep copy focused on revenue loss and captured intent
Focus hooks on the immediate financial and conversion cost of delayed replies
Emphasize the contrast between manual busywork and automated 24/7 capture
Use clean B2B SaaS visuals with high contrast, device mockups, and subtle purple accents
Keep caption openers concise, bold, and focused on customer pain points
dont: Use overly technical jargon without explaining the business benefit
Make captions overly fluffy or conversational without a core problem-solution dynamic
Ignore local tech events and networking opportunities
Ignore the frustration of manual follow-ups
Don't get bogged down in technical AI jargon or complex n8n node architecture
Don't use generic stock photography; stick to clean 3D renders or branded SaaS graphic layouts
Don't sell features without directly tying them to saved hours or captured revenue
Don't use low-contrast or cluttered typography that reduces readability on mobile feeds
